description: Source code for launching and managing a browser application within the Playwright testing framework, including functions to launch apps, install icons, and sync local storage with settings.

classes.name: ProgressController
classes.description: Class managing progress during asynchronous operations.

methods.name: launchApp
methods.description: Launches a browser app with specified options, handling platform-specific behavior and errors.

methods.name: installAppIcon
methods.description: Reads an app icon file and sets it as the dock tile on macOS for Chromium browsers.

methods.name: syncLocalStorageWithSettings
methods.description: Synchronizes local storage settings from a JSON file into the browser page context.
